prompt:
Subject: Taking a break at a multi-function printer

Main Figure: A single young adult woman sitting on the glass surface of a large commercial multi-function printer with its lid open in a bright office. Place the person large in the center, featuring the whole body from head to black pumps, pale blue shirt, black tie, and short pants, with the blue-glowing scan surface as the main element.

Character/Expression: A small oval face, bright smooth skin, large dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, and slightly parted pale coral lips. Faces the camera directly with a quiet and calm expression. Thin eyeliner, long eyelashes, pale pink cheeks. Dark brown straight hair close to black reaching below the chest, thin bangs close to a center part, long hair strands around the face, and hair falling from the right shoulder to the chest.

Clothing/Pose: Very pale blue-grey long-sleeved button shirt with a collar, sleeves folded to below the elbows, and several top buttons open. A thin black tie loosely hanging from the neck, black high-waisted shorts, and glossy black pointed-toe high-heel pumps. Sits on the front edge of the printer's glass surface with both legs spread forward and lowered. Place the left hand on the blue-glowing glass surface and rest the right forearm on the right thigh with fingers hanging naturally.

Background/Light: A large black-and-white multi-function printer from the left to the center, a black document cover opened upwards, and bluish-white light inside. Diagonally placed control panel with a blue round button in the right foreground, and a sheet of paper in the discharge area below. White cabinet, small printer, white-potted indoor plant, and window with blinds in the right background. Strong but soft daylight from the top right window illuminates the face, shirt, and both legs. The blue light from the scan surface reflects faintly on the left hand and lower side.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4. A full-body seated portrait captured from the front from a camera slightly lower than the seat surface. The top of the head is near the top edge, and both pumps are near the left and right bottom edges, placing the person large in the center. Position the trapezoid of the open cover behind and the control panel diagonally at the bottom right. Precisely focused on the face, body, and front of the printer, with a medium depth of field where the background furniture becomes slightly soft.

Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic live-action photo combining window light and machine light. Realistically depict skin, thin hair strands, thin weave and wrinkles of the shirt, black cloth, gloss of the pumps, resin/glass/LCD/buttons of the printer, and paper. Clean office colors of white, black, and pale blue, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or illustration styles.

Negative: Alteration of facial features, clothing, sitting posture on the printer, or limb positions.

promptZh:
主题：在多功能打印机旁休息

主体人物：一位 年轻女性 坐在明亮办公室里一台打开盖子的大型商用多功能打印机的玻璃表面上。将人物置于画面中心，展示从头部到黑色高跟鞋的全身，身穿 淡蓝色衬衫、黑色领带和 短裤，以发出蓝色光芒的扫描表面为主要元素。

角色/表情：小巧的椭圆形脸庞，明亮光滑的皮肤，深棕色大眼睛，细长的自然眉毛，小鼻子，微张的珊瑚色嘴唇。直视镜头，表情安静从容。画着细眼线，长睫毛，淡粉色脸颊。深棕色直发近乎黑色，长度过胸，中间偏分的薄刘海，脸颊两侧有长发丝，头发从右肩垂至胸前。

服装/姿势：极淡的蓝灰色长袖翻领衬衫，袖子卷至肘部下方，领口上方几颗扣子解开。脖子上松散地挂着一条细黑领带，穿着黑色高腰短裤和亮面黑色尖头高跟鞋。坐在打印机玻璃表面的前缘，双腿向前分开下垂。左手放在发出蓝光的玻璃表面上，右前臂搁在右大腿上，手指自然下垂。

背景/光线：从左侧到中心是一台大型黑白多功能打印机，黑色文档盖向上打开，内部透出蓝白色的光。右前方是斜放的控制面板，上面有一个蓝色圆形按钮，下方的出纸口有一张纸。背景右侧是白色柜子、小型打印机、白色花盆里的室内植物以及带有百叶窗的窗户。来自右上角窗户的强烈而柔和的日光照亮了脸部、衬衫和双腿。扫描表面发出的蓝光微弱地反射在左手和身体下侧。

构图/相机：垂直 3:4 比例。从略低于座椅表面的角度拍摄的全身坐姿肖像。头顶靠近画面上边缘，两只高跟鞋靠近左下和右下边缘，将人物置于画面中心。打开的盖子呈梯形位于身后，控制面板斜置于右下方。焦点精确对准脸部、身体和打印机前部，中等景深，背景家具略显柔和。

质感/风格：结合窗光与机器光的高清写实照片。真实地描绘皮肤、细发丝、衬衫的细密纹理与褶皱、黑色布料、高跟鞋的光泽、打印机的树脂/玻璃/液晶显示屏/按钮以及纸张。采用白色、黑色和淡蓝色的干净办公室色调，避免过度磨皮或插画风格。

负面提示词：改变面部特征、服装、在打印机上的坐姿或肢体位置。
